issues.description: DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE 'python:3.12' is duplicated across Python and TypeScript instead of a single source of truth.
issues.detail: The literal lives in pipeline.py, the jinja fallback, Commands.ts error fallback, and CellMetadataEditor.tsx. The RPC get_default_base_image exists precisely to centralize this. Remove the TS constant and literal fallbacks; rely on the RPC value with one clearly-marked emergency fallback so the displayed default cannot drift from the compiled default.

issues.description: Changing _set_base_image from '' to hardcoded 'python:3.12' silently overrides KFP's own default resolution.
issues.detail: Previously, base_image='' on pod-introspection failure deferred to kfp_dsl's default. The new code substitutes 'python:3.12' unconditionally, breaking the contract for callers that distinguished empty (delegate) from concrete tag. The comment above still says 'Use kfp default image' but the code no longer does. Restore '' or migrate callers and update the comment explicitly.

issues.description: Replacing the inline Input with a Button+Dialog regresses observable state and adds framework without justification.
issues.detail: The previous UI exposed the current base image directly in an editable Input; the new UI hides it behind a modal labeled 'IMAGE' that is disabled until stepName is set. This strengthens a precondition and removes at-a-glance visibility of the current value. A placeholder on the original Input would have surfaced the default with zero new components.

issues.description: The effective-base-image precedence chain is reimplemented at multiple call sites instead of one resolver.
issues.detail: The chain 'baseImage || pipelineBaseImage || defaultBaseImage || DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE' appears in InlineMetadata.createBaseImageText, the Dialog placeholder, and the jinja template (in a different order). Factor this into one resolveBaseImage operation with a stated contract — ideally resolved server-side in the compiler — and pass one resolved string down.

issues.description: DefaultState.defaultBaseImage='' is a smuggled sentinel conflating not-loaded, loaded-as-default, and loaded-as-other.
issues.detail: The empty string encodes three distinct states in one field, forcing children to use truthy-fallback chains to recover. This is control flow encoded in a value rather than a type, and it drives the prop-drilling through LeftPanel -> InlineCellsMetadata -> editor. A discriminated union, null, or a small context would make the invariant explicit and collapse the drilling.

issues.description: Button width: '5%' inside a percentage-width flex row is a fragile, unreasoned layout contract.
issues.detail: The replaced Input was 25%; the new Button at 5% inside a 'padding: 0' div will not fit the word 'IMAGE' at most viewport widths and depends on parent context the component cannot see. Either size by content (auto) and let MUI handle it, or own the layout contract at the row level with a documented rationale.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on a clear verdict: the PR's goal (surface the default base image) is sensible but the execution duplicates the 'python:3.12' literal across Python and TypeScript, defeating the very RPC introduced to centralize it. The pipeline.py change from '' to a hardcoded default silently overrides KFP's own default resolution and contradicts the comment above it — a real contract break. The UI regresses observable state by replacing an editable Input with a modal Button labeled 'IMAGE', and the effective-image precedence chain is reimplemented at multiple sites that can drift. Consolidate to one server-resolved value, restore or document the pipeline semantics, and simplify the UI back toward the original Input.
